theorems.name: Submission.allard52_center_density_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (ω R Λ M : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < Λ → 0 ≤ M → g y = 0 → (∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, μ (closedBall y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M) → (∀ r ∈ Ioo 0 R, Real.exp (-Λ) ≤ F r ∧ F r ≤ Real.exp Λ ∧ |F r - 1| ≤ Λ) → (∀ s r : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r → r < R → F s * (s ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y s)).toReal + F s - 1 ≤ F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1 ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y r \ closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp Λ * ((F r * (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y r)).toReal + F r - 1) - (F s * (s ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y s)).toReal + F s - 1)))) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < R → μ (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.exp (2 * Λ) * (M / R ^ n) + 2 * Real.exp Λ * Λ) * s ^ n) ∧ ((∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 R, ω ≤ F t * (t ^ n)⁻¹ * (μ (closedBall y t)).toReal + F t - 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ) * (ω - Λ) * s ^ n) ≤ μ (closedBall y s) ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (g x) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp Λ * (Real.exp Λ * (M / R ^ n) + Λ - ω)))
